parsed.name: ROSBridge WebSocket连接组件
parsed.description: 用于与ROSBridge服务器建立并维护WebSocket通信的非物理软件组件，可在实验系统中发送字符串消息、接收消息，并将收到的数据分发给已注册的回调函数。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that establishes and maintains WebSocket communication with a ROSBridge server, used in lab systems to send string messages, receive incoming messages, and dispatch received data to registered callbacks.

actions.description_en: Send a string message through the WebSocket connection.
Handle a WebSocket connection error event.
Start and run the WebSocket connection process.

actions.description: 处理收到的消息并调用已注册的回调函数。
actions.description_en: Handle an incoming message and invoke registered callbacks.

actions.description: 注册用于处理收到消息的回调函数。
actions.description_en: Register a callback function for handling incoming messages.
